title: 第13章 炼狱不死山

content_zh:
这种蜕变，速度并不快，但是可以感知到进步，这进步其实也已经非常惊人了。
不仅如此，随着修炼，姜辰感应到这片空间的海洋里的海水，有一些水汽开始汇聚而来。
开始的时候，这种情况并不明显。
但随着修炼加深，姜辰立刻察觉到一股股清凉的能量，不断的蜕变自己的灵魂，而之前的受伤情况，也迅速的恢复了。
那面对修罗黑山的巨大压力，也因此而开始减弱。
“那海洋，果然全部都是灵魂能量！”
姜辰心中震撼，骇然。
那一片巨大的海洋，全部是灵魂能量的话，那是什么灵魂能量！
那灵魂能量，若是自己炼化，岂不是飞天遁地，翻江倒海，毁天灭地？
姜辰想想，就觉得浑身气血暴涨，热血沸腾。
姜辰继续修炼，越来越多的灵魂力量开始汇聚而来。
面对修罗紫山的压力，也开始越来越小。
又过了一刻钟的时间，姜辰已经感受不到压力。
当下，姜辰站了起来，朝前又踏出了五步。
这个时候，压力也并不是特别大。
当下，姜辰一咬牙，直接前行，走到了修罗黑山入口前一米的地方。
这个时候，巨大的压力，压迫得姜辰身体都弯曲了下来，头部更是沉重得抬不起来，脑袋如要掉落一样。
姜辰骇然，立刻盘坐而下，再次修炼魂道功法《修罗炼魂诀》。
这一次，历经了初始的艰难状态之后，一切又继续一如之前。
不过，这次倒是顺利了许多。

足足一个时辰之后，姜辰再次的浑身轻松。
姜辰见到，黑色巨山的小路的长度，明显的增加了许多，紫色雾气，也浓郁了将近一倍。
也就是说，这一番修炼，他的灵魂强度，增加了一倍不止。
姜辰的灵魂强度，本就非常强大，毕竟融合了一个额外的灵魂，如今再次翻倍，这种强大，已经不可想象。
姜辰再次站了起来，然后向前踏出了一步，这一步踏出，几乎翻倍的压力碾压而来。
“嘶——”
姜辰不由倒吸一口冷气，额头上都冒出了冷汗。
当下，姜辰再次盘坐苦修。
将近两个时辰之后，姜辰的灵魂蜕变到了极致，隐约触摸到了一种灵魂的层次。
当即，姜辰没有停下，反而继续苦修。
又是半个时辰之后，姜辰的灵魂一震。
“嗡——”
一种飞仙的极致舒爽感渗透到了灵魂的每一个细胞里，姜辰只觉得，这个魂海空间，忽然变得明亮了十倍不止。
若是之前还只是昏昏暗暗的灰暗色的话，如今，便如青天大白日一样明亮！
不仅如此，姜辰发现，那修罗黑山的小路的蜿蜒距离，朦胧的距离能看到的有五百米之多，而清晰的，则只有十米左右。
这一点，倒是和他的灵魂魂力感应特征近似。
姜辰没有深想，而是松了口气，因为他感觉到，他有资格进入修罗黑山了。
姜辰站了起来，再次迈出了一步，终于踏入了黑山的入口处。
不过，这一次压力没有出现，反而，眼前的世界微微一变。
顿时，一座巨大的黑山直接遮蔽在了眼前，而姜辰则如站在一片巨大的峡谷之中一般。

这正是山底下。
姜辰回头，远方的魂海还在，但是却如与自己有着无尽的距离一样。
显然，黑山之中，如另外一个独立的世界一样。
姜辰出现在这里的时候，黑山微微的震荡了起来，随后，黑山之中的紫色云雾，逐渐的汇聚了起来，化作了一个身形巨大的中年男子形象。
男子有着一脸的络腮胡子，身上穿着一件紫色的长袍。长袍上有着许多凶兽的雕纹，每一个雕纹凶兽，都栩栩如生，如要择人而噬一样。
男子俯视着姜辰，眼中显出了恍然之色，开口说道：“辰辰，你如今踏入修罗炼狱不死山，应该是修罗魂道修炼有成，踏入修罗炼魂第一层的基本层次了。这很好，能在一百年的时间里，踏入这里，你的确是我姜家的绝世天才。”
“一百岁？”
姜辰微微吃惊，反问道。
男子似乎有所感应，点了点头，道：“怎么样，你父亲我的推衍很准吧？不过，你能百岁踏入不死山，的确是难得了。”
“……”
姜辰无言以对。
男子自顾自的继续说道：“我是你父亲姜无道。当然，此地的我只是曾经留下的守护烙印。你如今百岁，踏出了这无比艰难的第一步，灵魂洗筋伐髓、涅槃蜕变，便可有千年的寿命。之后的一千年，你只需要五百年，就可以踏入修罗炼魂的第二层了。

content_en:
This kind of transformation is not fast, but progress can be felt. This progress is actually very amazing.
Not only that, as he practiced, Jiang Chen sensed that some water vapor began to gather in the seawater in the ocean of this space.
At first, this is not obvious.
But as his practice deepened, Jiang Chen immediately noticed waves of cool energy, constantly transforming his soul, and the previous injuries also quickly recovered.
The huge pressure facing Shura Black Mountain began to weaken as a result.
"The ocean is indeed all soul energy!"
Jiang Chen was shocked and horrified.
If that huge ocean is all soul energy, what kind of soul energy is that!
If that soul energy were refined by oneself, wouldn't it mean that it would fly into the sky and escape from the earth, turn the rivers upside down, and destroy the heavens and the earth?
When Jiang Chen thought about it, he felt his blood surge and his blood boiling.
Jiang Chen continued to practice, and more and more soul power began to gather.
The pressure from Shura Zishan also began to decrease.
Another quarter of an hour passed, and Jiang Chen could no longer feel the pressure.
At that moment, Jiang Chen stood up and took five more steps forward.
At this time, the pressure is not particularly great.
At that moment, Jiang Chen gritted his teeth and moved forward directly, arriving one meter in front of the entrance of Shura Black Mountain.
At this time, the huge pressure forced Jiang Chen's body to bend, and his head was so heavy that he couldn't lift it up, as if his head was about to fall.
Jiang Chen was horrified, and immediately sat down cross-legged and practiced the soul path technique "Shura Soul Refining Technique" again.
This time, after the initial difficult situation, everything continued as before.
However, this time it was much smoother.
After a full hour, Jiang Chen felt relaxed again.
Jiang Chen saw that the length of the path on the giant black mountain had obviously increased a lot, and the purple mist was nearly twice as thick.
In other words, with this practice, his soul strength has more than doubled.
Jiang Chen's soul strength was already very powerful. After all, it was fused with an extra soul. Now it has doubled again. This kind of power is unimaginable.
Jiang Chen stood up again, and then took a step forward. With this step, the pressure was almost doubled.
"Hiss——"
Jiang Chen couldn't help but take a breath of cold air, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
At that moment, Jiang Chen sat cross-legged and practiced hard again.
Nearly two hours later, Jiang Chen's soul had transformed to the extreme, and he could vaguely touch a level of soul.
Immediately, Jiang Chen did not stop, but continued to practice hard.
After another half an hour, Jiang Chen's soul was shaken.
"Buzz——"
A kind of ultimate comfort of flying immortals penetrated into every cell of the soul. Jiang Chen only felt that the soul sea space suddenly became more than ten times brighter.
If it was just a dim gray color before, now it is as bright as the blue sky and the bright day!
Not only that, Jiang Chen discovered that the winding distance of the path in Shura Black Mountain could be seen in the hazy distance as much as 500 meters, while in the clear distance, it was only about ten meters.
This is similar to his soul power sensing characteristics.
Jiang Chen did not think deeply, but breathed a sigh of relief, because he felt that he was qualified to enter Shura Black Mountain.
Jiang Chen stood up, took another step, and finally stepped into the entrance of Black Mountain.
However, this time the pressure did not appear. Instead, the world in front of him changed slightly.
Suddenly, a huge black mountain directly covered his eyes, and Jiang Chen seemed to be standing in a huge canyon.
This is exactly what is at the bottom of the mountain.
Jiang Chen turned around, and the sea of ​​souls in the distance was still there, but it seemed like there was an endless distance from him.
Obviously, Black Mountain is like another independent world.
When Jiang Chen appeared here, the Black Mountain shook slightly, and then the purple in the Black MountainThe clouds of color gradually gathered together and transformed into the image of a huge middle-aged man.
The man had a beard and wore a purple robe. There are many carvings of ferocious beasts on the robe, and each carving of the ferocious beast is lifelike, as if it wants to choose someone to devour.
The man looked down at Jiang Chen, with a look of surprise in his eyes, and said: "Chenchen, you have now stepped into the Asura Purgatory Immortal Mountain. You should have successfully cultivated the Asura Soul Dao and entered the first basic level of the Asura Soul Refining. This is very good. To be able to step here in a hundred years, you are indeed the peerless genius of my Jiang family."
"A hundred years old?"
Jiang Chen was slightly surprised and asked.
The man seemed to sense something, nodded, and said: "How about your father and I are very accurate, right? However, it is indeed rare for you to be able to step into the Mountain of the Immortal to be a hundred years old."
"..."
Jiang Chen was speechless.
The man continued, minding his own business, "I am your father Jiang Wudao. Of course, I here am just the guardian mark I once left behind. You are now a hundred years old and have taken this extremely difficult first step. After your soul has been washed and marrowed, Nirvana transformed, you can live for a thousand years. In the next thousand years, you will only need five hundred years to step into the second level of Shura Soul Refining."
